items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: And your Varsity sides with Spivak.

ctx.x: Jean was already known in Detroit and they were getting this band together to open up the Graystone Ballroom. They decided to use Jean's name because he was well known. Now Jean didn't have to lead the band. But he, being a classical musician, just was not cut out too well. Actually he tried very hard but he just couldn't do it. And so that he and my brother worked together, we did the bookings and things like that. And Jean Goldkette was - well I don't know, he was mostly name. He never led the band.
